PAC PRIMARY SOURCE / CHECKED NOVEMBER 8, 2026

Same R3200. A specific optional assembly.

A · Standard loading

R3200 using pre-opened bags on a roll; evaluate the standard hand-loading process.

B · Assisted loading

The same R3200, adding Easy Load Bag Opener and Seal Flattener Fingers. PAC describes an opening shaped for loading, a grip on the bag and film tensioning before sealing.

Bag width at least 10 inches. Fingers required with the opener.

Final application fit, scope, price and lead time must be confirmed by PAC.
